works.title: Political Game Theory Analysis Blog/Substack Series
works.description: Series of political analysis and game theory essays on Trump's economic and geopolitical failures, Democratic strategy, and cascading consequences of US policy reversals. Operationalized as blog posts posted via Substack using a pen name. User frames this as a four-year urgent project in response to Trump's second term.
works.quote: I need to start the habit of putting these out as blog posts. I just need to get the draft out there because this is really good game theory analysis that deserves to be in the public realm

works.title: Meme Warfare Strategic Framework
works.description: An 830-page strategic framework exploring meme warfare tactics and left-wing activist strategy for presidential campaigns, written in a nine-day sprint with AI assistance in early April 2025 and split into three parts. Serves as the intellectual foundation for ongoing left-wing activist campaign work using a pen name.
works.quote: I wrote an 830-page book that I then had to split into three parts—all completed in nine days with AI assistance. In that book, I talk about meme warfare, but just on a conceptual basis

works.title: Labor Analysis Reference Reports Series
works.description: A numbered series of comprehensive reference reports analyzing labor standards, worker power, and related policy issues. Report 2.11 specifically covers minimum wage trends and history, union density development, and non-compete litigation.
works.quote: Report 2.11: Labor Standards and Worker Power Produce a comprehensive reference report on labor standards and worker power distributional analysis
